            Dim n = request.Total1, a = request.Responders1, b = request.Responders2, both = request.Both

            CI(metrics, "paired", interval)
            Return New ContingencyReportResult({table}, Array.Empty(Of SpreadsheetValidationIssue)(), metrics)

            Return Not Double.IsNaN(value) AndAlso Not Double.IsInfinity(value)

            Return New ContingencySemanticTable({title, ""}, body, rows)

            metrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact(name & ".estimate", value.Estimate, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic))
            metrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact(name & ".lower", value.LowerLimit, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic))
            metrics.Add(New AnalysisMetricArtifact(name & ".upper", value.UpperLimit, AnalysisMetricRole.Statistic))
        End Sub

        ''' <summary>
        ''' Adds a Love plot chart to an existing worksheet.  The chart is built from
        ''' the supplied rows, so it does not depend on exact cell locations produced
        ''' by ExcelDnaResultWriter formatting.
        ''' </summary>
        Public Shared Sub AddChart(ws As Worksheet,
                                   rows As IList(Of PsmLovePlotRow),
                                   Optional left As Double = 420,
                                   Optional top As Double = 20,
                                   Optional width As Double = 720,
                                   Optional height As Double = 420)
            If ws Is Nothing OrElse rows Is Nothing OrElse rows.Count = 0 Then Return

            AddProjectedChart(ws, New PsmLovePlotProjection(rows), left, top, width, height)
        End Sub

        Public Shared Sub AddProjectedChart(ws As Worksheet, projection As PsmLovePlotProjection,
                                            Optional left As Double = 420, Optional top As Double = 20,
                                            Optional width As Double = 720, Optional height As Double = 420)
            If ws Is Nothing OrElse projection Is Nothing OrElse projection.Count = 0 Then Return
            Dim spec As New PsmLoveChartSpec35(projection)
            Dim yValues = spec.YValues
            Dim xBefore = spec.Before
            Dim xAfterMatching = spec.AfterMatching
            Dim xAfterWeighting = spec.AfterWeighting
            Dim labels = spec.Labels
            Dim threshold = spec.Threshold
            Dim maxX = spec.MaximumX

            Dim shp As Shape = ws.Shapes.AddChart(Left:=left, Top:=top, Width:=width, Height:=height)
            Dim ch As Chart = shp.Chart
            With ch
                .ChartType = XlChartType.xlXYScatter

                Do Until .SeriesCollection.Count = 0
                    .SeriesCollection(1).Delete()
                Loop

                Dim plottedSeries As New List(Of Integer)()
                If spec.IncludesChannel(0) Then plottedSeries.Add(AddScatterSeries(ch, spec.NameForChannel(0), xBefore, yValues, RGB(120, 120, 120), XlMarkerStyle.xlMarkerStyleCircle))
                If spec.IncludesChannel(1) Then plottedSeries.Add(AddScatterSeries(ch, spec.NameForChannel(1), xAfterMatching, yValues, RGB(31, 119, 180), XlMarkerStyle.xlMarkerStyleDiamond))
                If spec.IncludesChannel(2) Then plottedSeries.Add(AddScatterSeries(ch, spec.NameForChannel(2), xAfterWeighting, yValues, RGB(44, 160, 44), XlMarkerStyle.xlMarkerStyleSquare))

                AddThresholdSeries(ch, threshold, projection.Count)

                If plottedSeries.Count > 0 Then
                    AddVariableLabels(CType(.SeriesCollection(plottedSeries(spec.LabelSeriesOrdinal)), Series), labels)
                End If

                .HasTitle = True
                .ChartTitle.Text = spec.Title
                .HasLegend = True
                .Legend.Position = XlLegendPosition.xlLegendPositionBottom

                With .Axes(XlAxisType.xlCategory)
                    .MinimumScale = spec.MinimumX
                    .MaximumScale = maxX
                    .MajorUnitIsAuto = True
                    .HasTitle = True
                    .AxisTitle.Text = spec.XAxisTitle
                    Try
                        .MajorGridlines.Border.Color = RGB(230, 230, 230)
                    Catch
                    End Try
                End With

                With .Axes(XlAxisType.xlValue)
                    .MinimumScale = spec.MinimumY
                    .MaximumScale = spec.MaximumY
                    .MajorUnit = 1
                    .ReversePlotOrder = spec.ReverseY
                    .HasTitle = False
                    Try
                        .TickLabelPosition = XlTickLabelPosition.xlTickLabelPositionNone
                    Catch
                    End Try
                    Try
                        .MajorGridlines.Delete()
                    Catch
                    End Try
                End With
            End With
        End Sub

        Private Shared Function AddScatterSeries(ch As Chart,
                                                 name As String,
                                                 xValues As Double(),
                                                 yValues As Double(),
                                                 color As Integer,
                                                 markerStyle As XlMarkerStyle) As Integer
            ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries()
            Dim index As Integer = ch.SeriesCollection.Count
            With ch.SeriesCollection(index)
                .Name = name
                .XValues = xValues
                .Values = yValues
                .ChartType = XlChartType.xlXYScatter
                .MarkerStyle = markerStyle
                .MarkerSize = 6
                .MarkerForegroundColor = color
                .MarkerBackgroundColor = color
                .Format.Line.Visible = False
            End With
            Return index
        End Function

        Private Shared Sub AddThresholdSeries(ch As Chart, threshold As Double, n As Integer)
            ch.SeriesCollection.NewSeries()
            Dim s As Series = CType(ch.SeriesCollection(ch.SeriesCollection.Count), Series)
            With s
                .Name = PsmLoveChartSpec35.ThresholdSeriesName
                .XValues = PsmLoveSeriesPolicy.ThresholdReference(threshold, n).XValues
                .Values = PsmLoveSeriesPolicy.ThresholdReference(threshold, n).YValues
                .ChartType = XlChartType.xlXYScatterLinesNoMarkers
                Try
                    .Border.Color = RGB(180, 0, 0)
                    .Border.Weight = XlBorderWeight.xlMedium
                Catch
                End Try
            End With
        End Sub

        Private Shared Sub AddVariableLabels(series As Series, labels As String())
            If series Is Nothing OrElse labels Is Nothing OrElse labels.Length = 0 Then Return
            Try
                series.ApplyDataLabels()
                For Each ordinal As Integer In ComparisonChartPolicy35.LabelOrdinals(labels.Length, series.Points.Count)
                    Dim i As Integer = ComparisonChartPolicy35.PointIndex(ordinal)
                    Dim pt As Point = CType(series.Points(i), Point)
                    pt.DataLabel.Text = ComparisonChartPolicy35.LabelAt(labels, ordinal).Text
                    pt.DataLabel.Position = XlDataLabelPosition.xlLabelPositionRight
                    pt.DataLabel.Font.Size = 8
                Next
            Catch
                'Data labels are helpful but not essential; keep chart creation robust.
            End Try
        End Sub

        Return PsmLoveSeriesPolicy.HasAnyFinite(values)
    End Function

    Private Sub BindPilotLifecycle(run As WindowsExecutionRun)
        Dim app = AppGlobals.app
        Dim owner As Workbook = app.ActiveWorkbook
        run.BindInputAddresses(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit1.Address)
        run.Lifecycle = WindowsDocumentLifecycle.Create(app)
        Dim sourceSheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(run.SourceAddress, If(Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook, owner))
        Dim sourceBook = DirectCast(sourceSheet.Parent, Workbook)
        pilotAcquisitionBookId = ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.TargetIdentity(sourceBook)
        run.Lifecycle.Watch(Function() WindowsDocumentLifecycle.Observe(app, sourceBook, sourceSheet))
        If Me.optByID.Checked Then
            Dim groupSheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(run.GroupAddress, If(Me.RefEdit1.ExcelWorkBook, owner))
            Dim groupBook = DirectCast(groupSheet.Parent, Workbook)
            If ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.TargetIdentity(groupBook) <> pilotAcquisitionBookId Then Throw New DocumentLifecycleException(DocumentInvalidationReason.DocumentChanged)
            run.Lifecycle.Watch(Function() WindowsDocumentLifecycle.Observe(app, groupBook, groupSheet))
        End If
        pilotTarget = New SpreadsheetOutputTarget With {.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.CurrentWorksheet,
            .WorksheetName = Nothing, .StartRow = 1, .StartColumn = 1}
        pilotWorkbook = Nothing : pilotWorksheet = Nothing
        If Me.optWorkbook.Checked Then
            pilotTarget.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorkbook
        ElseIf Me.optWorksheet.Checked Then
            pilotTarget.Destination = SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet
            pilotWorkbook = owner
            run.Lifecycle.Watch(Function() WindowsDocumentLifecycle.Observe(app, owner, Nothing), requiresWorksheet:=False)
        Else

            Dim boundBook = pilotWorkbook, boundSheet = pilotWorksheet

        run.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()

    Private Function getData2Groups(ByRef strErr As String) As TwoGroupsData

        Dim groupIDs() As Object

        If Me.optByColumn.Checked Then

            ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(columData2, prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address), True)

            out.X1 = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columData.DataDbl, 0)
            out.X2 = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columData2.DataDbl, 0)

            out.name2 = columData2.varNames(0)
        Else
            'Group by identifier. We expect only two groups for Mann-Whitney test
            If WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit1.Address, True) <> WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, True) Then
                CoreServices.Errors.LogAndThrow(New ArgumentException("Input reference range adresses are from different sheets. Input can be only from one sheet."))
            End If

            refId = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit1.Address)
            refData = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address)
            'join reference address into one (remove sheet name from the second and concatenate).
            'Data can be only form one sheet because of the above check
            refFinal = refId & ", " & Replace(refData, WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(refData, True) & "!", String.Empty) 'Remove "Sheet1!" from string
            ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(columData, refFinal, True, 0)

            'get unique group IDs

            groupIDs = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columData.FinalData, 0).Distinct().ToArray()
            If groupIDs.Length <> 2 Then strErr = "Number Of groups must be eq 2"

            Dim coljagged()() As Double = columData.DataByID2ByColumn()
            out.X1 = coljagged(0)
            out.X2 = coljagged(1)
            out.name1 = CStr(groupIDs(0))
            out.name2 = CStr(groupIDs(1))
        End If

    Private Function getGroupedContinuousDataByColumn(ByRef strErr As String) As GroupedContinuousInputData
        'Wide layout: each selected worksheet column is one group. Missing values
        'are handled independently within each column, so rows do not need to be
        'paired across groups. This path is shared by violin plots and categorical
        'histograms.
        Dim dataWorksheet As Worksheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim ref As String = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim colList() As String = ColumListFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)

        If colList Is Nothing OrElse colList.Length = 0 Then
            strErr = "Select at least one continuous data column."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim groups As New List(Of Object)()
        Dim usedGroupNames As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase)

        For i As Integer = 0 To colList.Length - 1
            Dim columnAddress As String = LTrim$(colList(i))
            Dim columnRef As String = WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(ref, True, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook) & "!" & columnAddress
            Dim columnData As New DataObj
            ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(columnData, columnRef, True)

            'Completely empty/non-numeric columns are simply omitted, matching the
            'existing multiple-groups by-column import behaviour.
            If columnData.bZeroValid OrElse columnData.FinalData Is Nothing OrElse columnData.nRows = 0 Then
                Continue For
            End If
            If columnData.nCols <> 1 Then
                strErr = "Each by-column input must resolve to a single worksheet column."
                Return Nothing
            End If

            Dim sourceRange As Range = dataWorksheet.Range(columnAddress)
            Dim firstRowIsTextLabel As Boolean = False
            Dim groupName As String = ResolveGroupedColumnName(sourceRange, firstRowIsTextLabel)
            groupName = MakeUniqueGroupedColumnName(groupName, usedGroupNames)

            Dim columnValues() As Double = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columnData.DataDbl, 0)
            Dim firstValueIndex As Integer = 0

            'A numeric-looking text header (for example "0") is accepted by DataObj
            'as numeric data. If that first worksheet row was explicitly text, remove
            'it from the plotted observations while retaining it as the group label.
            If firstRowIsTextLabel AndAlso columnData.RowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso
               columnData.RowIds.Length > 0 AndAlso columnData.RowIds(0) = sourceRange.Row Then
                firstValueIndex = 1
            End If

            For valueIndex As Integer = firstValueIndex To columnValues.Length - 1
                values.Add(columnValues(valueIndex))
                groups.Add(groupName)
            Next
        Next

        If values.Count = 0 Then
            strErr = "No valid continuous observations were found in the selected columns."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Return New GroupedContinuousInputData With {
            .Values = values.ToArray(),
            .Groups = groups.ToArray(),
            .ContinuousName = "Value",
            .GroupName = "Group"
        }
    End Function

    Private Shared Function ResolveGroupedColumnName(sourceRange As Range, ByRef firstRowIsTextLabel As Boolean) As String
        firstRowIsTextLabel = False
        If sourceRange Is Nothing Then Return "Group"

        Dim firstCell As Range = DirectCast(sourceRange.Cells(1, 1), Range)
        Dim firstValue As Object = ExcelDnaDataImporter.NormalizeExcelValue(firstCell.Value2)

        'Any non-blank text in the first selected row is an explicit group label.
        'A genuinely numeric first value remains data and falls back to the Excel
        'column identifier (A, B, C, ...).
        If TypeOf firstValue Is String Then
            Dim textLabel As String = CStr(firstValue).Trim()
            If textLabel <> String.Empty Then
                firstRowIsTextLabel = True
                Return textLabel
            End If
        End If

        Dim entireColumnAddress As String = DirectCast(sourceRange.Cells(1, 1), Range).EntireColumn.Address(False, False)
        Dim columnName As String = entireColumnAddress.Split(":"c)(0).Replace("$", String.Empty)
        Return columnName
    End Function

    Private Shared Function MakeUniqueGroupedColumnName(groupName As String, usedNames As Dictionary(Of String, Integer)) As String
        Dim baseName As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(groupName), "Group", groupName.Trim())
        Dim occurrence As Integer = 0

        If usedNames.TryGetValue(baseName, occurrence) Then
            occurrence += 1
            usedNames(baseName) = occurrence
            Return baseName & " (" & occurrence.ToString() & ")"
        End If

        usedNames.Add(baseName, 1)
        Return baseName
    End Function

    Private Function getGroupedContinuousDataById(ByRef strErr As String) As GroupedContinuousInputData
        'Resolve the ranges using the workbook associated with each RefEdit.
        Dim groupWorksheet As Worksheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit1.Address, Me.RefEdit1.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim dataWorksheet As Worksheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim groupWorkbook As Workbook = DirectCast(groupWorksheet.Parent, Workbook)
        Dim dataWorkbook As Workbook = DirectCast(dataWorksheet.Parent, Workbook)

        'Both variables must come from the same workbook and worksheet.
        If Not String.Equals(groupWorkbook.FullName, dataWorkbook.FullName,
                         StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
           Not String.Equals(groupWorksheet.Name, dataWorksheet.Name,
                             StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then

            strErr = "Categorical and continuous variables must be on the same worksheet."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim groupRange As Range = groupWorksheet.Range(Me.RefEdit1.Address)
        Dim dataRange As Range = dataWorksheet.Range(Me.RefEdit2.Address)

        'Each input must be a single continuous range.
        If groupRange.Areas.Count <> 1 OrElse dataRange.Areas.Count <> 1 Then
            strErr = "Each grouping/continuous input must be one continuous column range."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        'The categorical and continuous observations are paired row-by-row.
        If groupRange.Row <> dataRange.Row OrElse groupRange.Rows.Count <> dataRange.Rows.Count Then
            strErr = "Categorical and continuous variable ranges must start on the same row and contain the same number of rows."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim imported = New DataObj
        Dim refId As String = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit1.Address)
        Dim refData As String = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address)
        Dim refFinal As String = refId & ", " & Replace(refData, WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(refData, True) & "!", String.Empty)

        'The first imported column is categorical and may contain text;
        'the second must be numeric.
        ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(imported, refFinal, True, 0)

        If imported.bZeroValid OrElse imported.FinalData Is Nothing OrElse imported.nRows = 0 Then
            strErr = "No valid paired categorical/continuous observations were found."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        If imported.nCols <> 2 Then
            strErr = "This plot requires one grouping column and one continuous data column."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim out As New GroupedContinuousInputData With {
            .ContinuousName = imported.varNames(1),
            .GroupName = imported.varNames(0)
        }

        ReDim out.Values(imported.nRows - 1)
        ReDim out.Groups(imported.nRows - 1)

        For i As Integer = 0 To imported.nRows - 1
            out.Groups(i) = imported.FinalData(i, 0)
            out.Values(i) = CDbl(imported.FinalData(i, 1))
        Next

        Return out
    End Function

    Private Async Sub btCompute_Click(sender As Object, e As System.EventArgs) Handles btCompute.Click
        Dim diagnostic As WindowsDiagnosticRun = Nothing
        Dim run As WindowsExecutionRun = Nothing
        Dim enabledControls As New Dictionary(Of Control, Boolean)()
        Dim priorSynchronizationContext As System.Threading.SynchronizationContext = Nothing
        Dim installedUiContext As Boolean = False
        Try
            If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.OneWayANOVA OrElse Me.Tag = HelpTopic.KruskalWallisTest Then
                ' Excel-DNA shows this form modelessly from a Ribbon callback. It may
                ' not have installed a WinForms synchronization context, in which case
                ' a continuation could leave the UI thread. The entire Excel COM
                ' and WinForms continuation must execute on the owning Excel UI thread.
                priorSynchronizationContext = System.Threading.SynchronizationContext.Current
                If Not TypeOf priorSynchronizationContext Is WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext Then
                    System.Threading.SynchronizationContext.SetSynchronizationContext(
                        New WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext())
                    installedUiContext = True
                End If
                run = executionDispatcher.TryBegin()
                If run Is Nothing Then Return
                executionRun = run
                LastSharedWriteOutcome = Nothing
                lastPilotFault = Nothing
                For Each control As Control In Controls
                    If control Is executionPanel Then Continue For
                    enabledControls.Add(control, control.Enabled)
                    control.Enabled = False
                Next
                executionCancel.Enabled = True
                AddHandler run.Execution.Changed, Sub(snapshot)
                                                      If IsDisposed Then Return
                                                      Dim current = run.Execution.Snapshot
                                                      executionLabel.Text = current.State.ToString() & " | " & current.Stage.ToString() &
                                                          If(current.Percent.HasValue, " | " & current.Percent.ToString() & "%", "")
                                                  End Sub
                run.Execution.Start()
                diagnostic = New WindowsDiagnosticRun(If(Me.Tag = HelpTopic.OneWayANOVA,
                    Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.AnalysisIds.OneWayAnova, Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.AnalysisIds.KruskalWallis),
                    CoreServices.TraceExecutionLoggingEnabled, ExcelDnaHost.Diagnostics)
                executionLabel.AccessibleDescription = "Run " & diagnostic.RunId
                If Me.checkInputs() Then
                    diagnostic.Reject()
                    ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest, "Invalid selection")), diagnostic)
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                BindPilotLifecycle(run)
                ' Yield once with the normal message loop; all continuations retain UI ownership.
                Await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Yield()
                run.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Validation, 5)
            End If
            Dim errText As String = String.Empty
            Dim MWdata As TwoGroupsData, data As MultiGroupsUnpairedData

            'Validate Inputs
            If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnpairedTTest Then
                If Me.ValidateUnpairedTtestOptionInputs() Then Exit Sub
            Else
                If run Is Nothing AndAlso Me.checkInputs() Then
                    If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                        diagnostic.Reject()
                        ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest, "Invalid selection")), diagnostic)
                    End If
                    Exit Sub
                End If
            End If
            If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then diagnostic.EnterStage("acquisition")
            If run IsNot Nothing Then run.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Acquisition, 10)

            If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.CategoricalHistogram OrElse Me.Tag = HelpTopic.ViolinPlot Then
                Dim groupedData As GroupedContinuousInputData = Me.getGroupedContinuousData(errText)
                If errText <> String.Empty Then
                    MsgBox(errText, vbExclamation)
                    Exit Sub
                End If

                If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.CategoricalHistogram Then
                    Me.RunCategoricalHistogram(groupedData)
                Else
                    Me.RunViolinPlot(groupedData)
                End If

            ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.MannWhitneyTest Or Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnpairedTTest Or Me.Tag = HelpTopic.ROCCurve Then

                'Get Data
                MWdata = Me.getData2Groups(errText)
                If errText <> String.Empty Then
                    MsgBox(errText, vbExclamation)
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                data = New MultiGroupsUnpairedData
                data.X = {MWdata.X1, MWdata.X2}
                data.varNames = {MWdata.name1, MWdata.name2}

                If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.MannWhitneyTest Then
                    Me.RunMannWhitney(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnpairedTTest Then
                    Me.RunTtest(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.ROCCurve Then
                    Me.RunROC(data)
                End If
            Else
                'Get Data
                data = Me.getDataMultipleGroups(errText)
                run?.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()
                If run IsNot Nothing Then run.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Analysis, 30)
                If errText <> String.Empty Then
                    If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                        diagnostic.Reject()
                        ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest, "Invalid grouped input")), diagnostic)
                    Else
                        MsgBox(errText, vbExclamation)
                    End If
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then diagnostic.EnterStage("analysis")

                'Run analysis
                If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.KruskalWallisTest Then
                    Me.RunKruskallWalis(data, diagnostic)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.BoxAndWhiskers Then
                    Me.RunBoxAndWhiskers(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.OneWayANOVA Then
                    Me.RunOneWayANOVA(data, diagnostic)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.DescriptiveStatistics Then
                    Me.RunDescStat(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.NormalityTests Then
                    Me.RunNormality(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.Histogram Then
                    Me.RunHistogram(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.NormalPlot Then
                    Me.RunNormalPlot(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.HomogeneityOfVariance Then
                    Me.RunHomogeneityVar(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.Symmetry Then
                    Me.RunSymmetry(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnivariateOutliers Then
                    Me.RunOutliers(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.CDFplot Then
                    Me.RunCDFPlot(data)
                End If
            End If
        Catch ex As OperationCanceledException When run IsNot Nothing AndAlso ex.CancellationToken = run.Execution.Token AndAlso run.Execution.Snapshot.IsCancellationRequested
            run.Execution.TryFail(ex)
            If Not IsDisposed Then executionLabel.Text = run.FailureDisplay(ex, LastSharedWriteOutcome, If(diagnostic Is Nothing, Nothing, diagnostic.RunId))
        Catch ex As Exception
            If run IsNot Nothing Then run.Execution.TryFail(ex)
            If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                ' Native exception text can contain workbook paths/values. Retain only
                ' the run/stage and a mapped code in the default pilot diagnostic log.
                Try
                    CoreServices.Logger.Warn("ANOVA/KW execution failed. Run " & diagnostic.RunId &
                        " | stage " & If(run Is Nothing, "unknown", run.Execution.Snapshot.Stage.ToString()) &
                        " | code " & UserFaultMapper.FromException(ex).Code)
                Catch
                    ' A logging failure must never mask the original host exception.
                End Try
                If TypeOf ex Is SpreadsheetInputValidationException Then
                    diagnostic.Reject()
                Else
                    diagnostic.Fail()
                End If
                ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromOutcome(run.Execution.Snapshot, LastSharedWriteOutcome, ex), diagnostic)
            Else
                CoreServices.Errors.LogAndThrow(ex, False, True)
            End If
        Finally
            If run IsNot Nothing Then
                If Not run.Execution.Snapshot.IsTerminal Then run.Execution.TryFail(New InvalidOperationException("Invocation did not complete."))
                Dim terminalFault = If(lastPilotFault, UserFaultMapper.FromOutcome(run.Execution.Snapshot, LastSharedWriteOutcome))
                run.Dispose()
                pilotWorkbook = Nothing : pilotWorksheet = Nothing : pilotTarget = Nothing
                pilotAcquisitionBookId = Nothing
                executionRun = Nothing
                If Not IsDisposed Then
                    executionLabel.Text = run.Execution.Snapshot.State.ToString() &
                        If(terminalFault Is Nothing, "", " | " & terminalFault.Code) & " | Run " & If(diagnostic Is Nothing, "", diagnostic.RunId)
                    executionToolTip.SetToolTip(executionLabel, UserFaultMapper.FormatDisplay(terminalFault, If(diagnostic Is Nothing, Nothing, diagnostic.RunId)))
                    executionCancel.Enabled = False
                    For Each pair In enabledControls
                        pair.Key.Enabled = pair.Value
                    Next
                End If
            End If
            If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                diagnostic.Dispose()
                If activeSharedOutputRun IsNot Nothing Then activeSharedOutputRun.Diagnostics = Nothing
                activeSharedOutputRun = Nothing
            End If
            If installedUiContext Then
                System.Threading.SynchronizationContext.SetSynchronizationContext(priorSynchronizationContext)
            End If
        End Try
    End Sub

    Private Sub RunHistogram(data As MultiGroupsUnpairedData)

        If Me.optSturges.Checked Then

        ElseIf Me.optDoane.Checked Then

        ElseIf Me.optScott.Checked Then

        ElseIf Me.optFreedmanDiaconis.Checked Then

        End If

            Dim hist = New graphics.Histogram(data.X(i))
            Dim d = hist.compute(Me.ckOverlay.Checked, strBiningTyp, Me.ckBoxPlot_Histogram.Checked)
            HisData.Add(d)
            histList.Add(hist)
        Next

        'descriptive statistics
        If Me.ckDescriptive_Histogram.Checked Then res.Add(Me.ComputeDescriptiveStats(data))

                    Exit Sub
                End If
            End If
        End If

        For i = 0 To histList.Count - 1
            Dim row As Integer = WriteRes.RowID
            Dim col As Integer = WriteRes.ColID

            histList(i).SetWs = WriteRes.ws
            Dim strHistogramTitle As String = $"Histogram {strBiningTyp} - {data.varNames(i)}"

            'For multiple variables, stack charts vertically instead of overlapping them.
            Dim chartCol As Integer = col
            If Me.ckDescriptive_Histogram.Checked Then chartCol += rr.TotCols + 1
            Dim chartRow As Integer = row + 1 + i * If(Me.ckBoxPlot_Histogram.Checked, 24, 21)

            histList(i).addChart(WriteRes.ws, chartRow, chartCol, strHistogramTitle, Me.ckBoxPlot_Histogram.Checked)
        Next i

        If Me.ckDescriptive_Histogram.Checked Then rr.writeToSheet(WriteRes, True)
    End Sub

    Private Sub RunCategoricalHistogram(data As GroupedContinuousInputData)
        If data Is Nothing Then Throw New ArgumentNullException(NameOf(data))

        Dim options As New CategoricalHistogramOptions

        If Me.optCatHistStackedBar.Checked Then
            options.PlotType = CategoricalHistogramPlotType.StackedBar
        ElseIf Me.optCatHistDifferentSampleSizes.Checked Then
            options.PlotType = CategoricalHistogramPlotType.DifferentSampleSizes
        ElseIf Me.optCatHistComparativeHorizontal.Checked Then
            options.PlotType = CategoricalHistogramPlotType.Comparative
            options.ComparativeOrientation = CategoricalHistogramComparativeOrientation.Horizontal
        ElseIf Me.optCatHistComparativeVertical.Checked Then
            options.PlotType = CategoricalHistogramPlotType.Comparative
            options.ComparativeOrientation = CategoricalHistogramComparativeOrientation.Vertical
        Else
            options.PlotType = CategoricalHistogramPlotType.BarsWithLegend
        End If

        If Me.optCatHistDoan.Checked Then
            options.BinningRule = CategoricalHistogramBinningRule.Doane
        ElseIf Me.optCatHistScott.Checked Then
            options.BinningRule = CategoricalHistogramBinningRule.Scott
        ElseIf Me.optCatHistFreedmanDiaconis.Checked Then
            options.BinningRule = CategoricalHistogramBinningRule.FreedmanDiaconis
        Else
            options.BinningRule = CategoricalHistogramBinningRule.Sturges
        End If

        Dim result As CategoricalHistogramResult = CategoricalHistogram.Compute(data.Values, data.Groups, options)

        Dim isComparative As Boolean = (options.PlotType = CategoricalHistogramPlotType.Comparative)
        Dim appearance As New CategoricalHistogramAppearance With {
            .ChartTitle = If(isComparative, "Comparative histogram - ", "Categorical histogram - ") & data.ContinuousName & " by " & data.GroupName,
            .XAxisTitle = data.ContinuousName,
            .ShowLegend = True,
            .GapWidth = CInt(Me.nudCatHistGapWidth.Value),
            .SeriesOverlap = If(isComparative, 100, CInt(Me.nudCatHistSeriesOverlap.Value)),
            .SeriesColors = Me.GetGroupedPlotPalette(Me.cmbCatHistPalette.SelectedIndex)
        }

        Dim WriteRes = GetResultWriter()
        Dim chartAnchor As Range = DirectCast(WriteRes.ws.Cells(WriteRes.RowID, WriteRes.ColID), Range)

        CategoricalHistogramExcel.AddChart(WriteRes.ws,
                                           result,
                                           appearance,
                                           CDbl(chartAnchor.Left),
                                           CDbl(chartAnchor.Top))
    End Sub

    Private Sub RunViolinPlot(data As GroupedContinuousInputData)

    Private Function ParseCDFPercentiles() As Double()
        Dim textValue As String = If(Me.txtCDFPercentiles.Text, String.Empty).Trim()
        If textValue = String.Empty Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("Enter at least one percentile between 0 and 100.")
        End If

        textValue = textValue.Replace(ControlChars.Cr, ";").Replace(ControlChars.Lf, ";").Replace(ControlChars.Tab, ";")

        Dim decimalSeparator As String = Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator
        If decimalSeparator <> "," Then textValue = textValue.Replace(",", ";")

        Dim tokens() As String = textValue.Split(New Char() {";"c}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()

        For Each token As String In tokens
            Dim trimmed As String = token.Trim()
            If trimmed = String.Empty Then Continue For

            Dim percentile As Double
            Dim parsed As Boolean = Double.TryParse(trimmed,
                                                    Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,
                                                    Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
                                                    percentile)
            If Not parsed Then
                parsed = Double.TryParse(trimmed,
                                         Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,
                                         Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                         percentile)
            End If

            If Not parsed Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid percentile value '" & trimmed & "'. Use semicolons to separate values, for example 25; 50; 75.")
            End If
            If Double.IsNaN(percentile) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(percentile) OrElse percentile <= 0.0R OrElse percentile >= 100.0R Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(txtCDFPercentiles),
                                                      "Percentiles must be greater than 0 and less than 100.")
            End If

            If Not values.Any(Function(value As Double) Math.Abs(value - percentile) <= 0.000000000001R) Then
                values.Add(percentile)
            End If
        Next

        If values.Count = 0 Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("Enter at least one percentile between 0 and 100.")
        End If

        values.Sort()
        Return values.ToArray()
    End Function

    Private Function RunSharedOutput(analysisId As String, result As Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetAnalysisResult,
                                     supplementary As List(Of ResultTable), alpha As Double,
                                     charts As Func(Of ExcelDnaResultWriter, Integer, IReadOnlyList(Of System.Action)),
                                     diagnostic As WindowsDiagnosticRun) As Boolean
        executionRun.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Output, 90)
        executionCancel.Enabled = False ' No interruption/rollback of the synchronous write.
        diagnostic.OutputAttempted()
        activeSharedOutputRun = New ExcelDnaSharedOutputRun() With {.Diagnostics = diagnostic}
        Dim host As New ExcelDnaSharedOutputHost With {
            .Revalidate = Sub()
                              executionRun.Execution.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                              executionRun.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()
                          End Sub,
            .Acquire = Function(run) GetSharedResultWriter(analysisId, result, supplementary),
            .Target = Function(writer) New Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetOutputTarget With {
                .Destination = activeSharedOutputRun.RequestedTarget.Destination, .WorksheetName = CStr(writer.ws.Name),
                .StartRow = writer.RowID, .StartColumn = writer.ColID},
            .Identities = Function(writer) Tuple.Create(ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.TargetIdentity(writer.wb), ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.TargetIdentity(writer.ws)),
            .InspectCharts = Function(writer, intent) ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.InspectChartSafety(intent, writer.wb, writer.ws),
            .ConfirmCharts = Function(observed) MsgBox("This sheet contains " & observed.ExistingShapeCount.ToString() &
                " existing chart(s) or shape(s). New charts will be added. Excel chooses some chart positions, so visual overlap cannot be checked in advance." &
                vbCrLf & "Continue adding charts and writing output?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Add charts?") = vbYes,
            .Charts = charts,
            .Inspect = Function(writer, intent) ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.InspectWrite(intent, writer.wb, writer.ws),
            .Confirm = Function(observed) MsgBox("Output range not empty! Overwrite?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Overwrite?") = vbYes}
        executionRun.Write(Function()
                               LastSharedWriteOutcome = activeSharedOutputRun.Execute(result, supplementary, AppGlobals.PValuePresentation, alpha, host)
                               diagnostic.OutputFinished(LastSharedWriteOutcome.State)
                               Return LastSharedWriteOutcome.State
                           End Function)
        If LastSharedWriteOutcome.State = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.OutputWriteState.Completed Then Return True
        If LastSharedWriteOutcome.State <> Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.OutputWriteState.CancelledByUser Then
            ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromWriteResult(LastSharedWriteOutcome), diagnostic)
        End If
        Return False

        activeSharedOutputRun.RequestedTarget = target
        activeSharedOutputRun.Stage = "destination-creation"
        executionRun.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()

        ' adding a sheet/book or re-resolve a potentially changed RefEdit destination.
        Dim writer As New ExcelDnaResultWriter(target.StartRow, target.StartColumn)
        If target.Destination = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorkbook Then

    Private Function ValidateUnpairedTtestOptionInputs() As Boolean
        If Me.Tag <> HelpTopic.UnpairedTTest Then Return False

        If (Me.optHypothesisNonInferiority_UTT.Checked OrElse Me.optHypothesisEquivalence_UTT.Checked) AndAlso Me.optByID.Checked Then
            MsgBox("For noninferiority or equivalence, use 'By Column' input so the direction is explicit: control/reference in Input 1 and experimental/test in Input 2.", vbExclamation)
            Me.TabControl1.SelectedIndex = 0
            Return True
        End If

        If Me.optHypothesisNonInferiority_UTT.Checked OrElse Me.optHypothesisEquivalence_UTT.Checked Then
            Dim marginValue As Double
            If Not Double.TryParse(Me.tbMargin_UTT.Text, Globalization.NumberStyles.Float, Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture, marginValue) Then
                MsgBox("Enter a numeric positive margin using '.' as the decimal separator.", vbExclamation)
                Return True
            End If
            If marginValue <= 0 Then
                MsgBox("Margin must be greater than zero.", vbExclamation)
                Return True
            End If
        End If

        Return False
    End Function

    Private Function GetUnpairedTtestMargin() As Double
        Dim marginValue As Double

            CoreServices.Errors.LogAndThrow(New ArgumentException("A numeric positive margin is required for noninferiority / equivalence."))
        End If
        If marginValue <= 0 Then
            CoreServices.Errors.LogAndThrow(New ArgumentException("Margin must be greater than zero."))
        End If
        Return marginValue
    End Function

    Private Function getData2Groups(ByRef strErr As String) As TwoGroupsData
        Dim out = New TwoGroupsData
        Dim columData = New DataObj, columData2 = New DataObj
        'for by ID declarations
        Dim refId As String, refData As String, refFinal As String
        Dim groupIDs() As Object

        If Me.optByColumn.Checked Then
            'Group by Column
            ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(columData, prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit1.Address), True)
            ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(columData2, prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address), True)

            out.X1 = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columData.DataDbl, 0)
            out.X2 = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columData2.DataDbl, 0)
            out.name1 = columData.varNames(0)
            out.name2 = columData2.varNames(0)
        Else
            'Group by identifier. We expect only two groups for Mann-Whitney test
            If WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit1.Address, True) <> WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, True) Then
                CoreServices.Errors.LogAndThrow(New ArgumentException("Input reference range adresses are from different sheets. Input can be only from one sheet."))
            End If

            refId = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit1.Address)
            refData = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address)
            'join reference address into one (remove sheet name from the second and concatenate).
            'Data can be only form one sheet because of the above check
            refFinal = refId & ", " & Replace(refData, WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(refData, True) & "!", String.Empty) 'Remove "Sheet1!" from string
            ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(columData, refFinal, True, 0)

            'get unique group IDs

            groupIDs = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columData.FinalData, 0).Distinct().ToArray()
            If groupIDs.Length <> 2 Then strErr = "Number Of groups must be eq 2"

            Dim coljagged()() As Double = columData.DataByID2ByColumn()
            out.X1 = coljagged(0)
            out.X2 = coljagged(1)
            out.name1 = CStr(groupIDs(0))
            out.name2 = CStr(groupIDs(1))
        End If

        Return out
    End Function

    Private Function getGroupedContinuousDataByColumn(ByRef strErr As String) As GroupedContinuousInputData
        'Wide layout: each selected worksheet column is one group. Missing values
        'are handled independently within each column, so rows do not need to be
        'paired across groups. This path is shared by violin plots and categorical
        'histograms.
        Dim dataWorksheet As Worksheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim ref As String = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim colList() As String = ColumListFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)

        If colList Is Nothing OrElse colList.Length = 0 Then
            strErr = "Select at least one continuous data column."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()
        Dim groups As New List(Of Object)()
        Dim usedGroupNames As New Dictionary(Of String, Integer)(StringComparer.CurrentCultureIgnoreCase)

        For i As Integer = 0 To colList.Length - 1
            Dim columnAddress As String = LTrim$(colList(i))
            Dim columnRef As String = WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(ref, True, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook) & "!" & columnAddress
            Dim columnData As New DataObj
            ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(columnData, columnRef, True)

            'Completely empty/non-numeric columns are simply omitted, matching the
            'existing multiple-groups by-column import behaviour.
            If columnData.bZeroValid OrElse columnData.FinalData Is Nothing OrElse columnData.nRows = 0 Then
                Continue For
            End If
            If columnData.nCols <> 1 Then
                strErr = "Each by-column input must resolve to a single worksheet column."
                Return Nothing
            End If

            Dim sourceRange As Range = dataWorksheet.Range(columnAddress)
            Dim firstRowIsTextLabel As Boolean = False
            Dim groupName As String = ResolveGroupedColumnName(sourceRange, firstRowIsTextLabel)
            groupName = MakeUniqueGroupedColumnName(groupName, usedGroupNames)

            Dim columnValues() As Double = Matrix.GetColumnFrom2Darray(columnData.DataDbl, 0)
            Dim firstValueIndex As Integer = 0

            'A numeric-looking text header (for example "0") is accepted by DataObj
            'as numeric data. If that first worksheet row was explicitly text, remove
            'it from the plotted observations while retaining it as the group label.
            If firstRowIsTextLabel AndAlso columnData.RowIds IsNot Nothing AndAlso
               columnData.RowIds.Length > 0 AndAlso columnData.RowIds(0) = sourceRange.Row Then
                firstValueIndex = 1
            End If

            For valueIndex As Integer = firstValueIndex To columnValues.Length - 1
                values.Add(columnValues(valueIndex))
                groups.Add(groupName)
            Next
        Next

        If values.Count = 0 Then
            strErr = "No valid continuous observations were found in the selected columns."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Return New GroupedContinuousInputData With {
            .Values = values.ToArray(),
            .Groups = groups.ToArray(),
            .ContinuousName = "Value",
            .GroupName = "Group"
        }
    End Function

    Private Shared Function ResolveGroupedColumnName(sourceRange As Range, ByRef firstRowIsTextLabel As Boolean) As String
        firstRowIsTextLabel = False
        If sourceRange Is Nothing Then Return "Group"

        Dim firstCell As Range = DirectCast(sourceRange.Cells(1, 1), Range)
        Dim firstValue As Object = ExcelDnaDataImporter.NormalizeExcelValue(firstCell.Value2)

        'Any non-blank text in the first selected row is an explicit group label.
        'A genuinely numeric first value remains data and falls back to the Excel
        'column identifier (A, B, C, ...).
        If TypeOf firstValue Is String Then
            Dim textLabel As String = CStr(firstValue).Trim()
            If textLabel <> String.Empty Then
                firstRowIsTextLabel = True
                Return textLabel
            End If
        End If

        Dim entireColumnAddress As String = DirectCast(sourceRange.Cells(1, 1), Range).EntireColumn.Address(False, False)
        Dim columnName As String = entireColumnAddress.Split(":"c)(0).Replace("$", String.Empty)
        Return columnName
    End Function

    Private Shared Function MakeUniqueGroupedColumnName(groupName As String, usedNames As Dictionary(Of String, Integer)) As String
        Dim baseName As String = If(String.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(groupName), "Group", groupName.Trim())
        Dim occurrence As Integer = 0

        If usedNames.TryGetValue(baseName, occurrence) Then
            occurrence += 1
            usedNames(baseName) = occurrence
            Return baseName & " (" & occurrence.ToString() & ")"
        End If

        usedNames.Add(baseName, 1)
        Return baseName
    End Function

    Private Function getGroupedContinuousDataById(ByRef strErr As String) As GroupedContinuousInputData
        'Resolve the ranges using the workbook associated with each RefEdit.
        Dim groupWorksheet As Worksheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit1.Address, Me.RefEdit1.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim dataWorksheet As Worksheet = WorksheetFromRefAdress(Me.RefEdit2.Address, Me.RefEdit2.ExcelWorkBook)
        Dim groupWorkbook As Workbook = DirectCast(groupWorksheet.Parent, Workbook)
        Dim dataWorkbook As Workbook = DirectCast(dataWorksheet.Parent, Workbook)

        'Both variables must come from the same workbook and worksheet.
        If Not String.Equals(groupWorkbook.FullName, dataWorkbook.FullName,
                         StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) OrElse
           Not String.Equals(groupWorksheet.Name, dataWorksheet.Name,
                             StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) Then

            strErr = "Categorical and continuous variables must be on the same worksheet."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim groupRange As Range = groupWorksheet.Range(Me.RefEdit1.Address)
        Dim dataRange As Range = dataWorksheet.Range(Me.RefEdit2.Address)

        'Each input must be a single continuous range.
        If groupRange.Areas.Count <> 1 OrElse dataRange.Areas.Count <> 1 Then
            strErr = "Each grouping/continuous input must be one continuous column range."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        'The categorical and continuous observations are paired row-by-row.
        If groupRange.Row <> dataRange.Row OrElse groupRange.Rows.Count <> dataRange.Rows.Count Then
            strErr = "Categorical and continuous variable ranges must start on the same row and contain the same number of rows."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim imported = New DataObj
        Dim refId As String = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit1.Address)
        Dim refData As String = prepareRef2D(Me.RefEdit2.Address)
        Dim refFinal As String = refId & ", " & Replace(refData, WorksheetNameFromRefAdress(refData, True) & "!", String.Empty)

        'The first imported column is categorical and may contain text;
        'the second must be numeric.
        ExcelDnaDataImporter.ImportInto(imported, refFinal, True, 0)

        If imported.bZeroValid OrElse imported.FinalData Is Nothing OrElse imported.nRows = 0 Then
            strErr = "No valid paired categorical/continuous observations were found."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        If imported.nCols <> 2 Then
            strErr = "This plot requires one grouping column and one continuous data column."
            Return Nothing
        End If

        Dim out As New GroupedContinuousInputData With {
            .ContinuousName = imported.varNames(1),
            .GroupName = imported.varNames(0)
        }

        ReDim out.Values(imported.nRows - 1)
        ReDim out.Groups(imported.nRows - 1)

        For i As Integer = 0 To imported.nRows - 1
            out.Groups(i) = imported.FinalData(i, 0)
            out.Values(i) = CDbl(imported.FinalData(i, 1))
        Next

        Return out
    End Function

    Private Async Sub btCompute_Click(sender As Object, e As System.EventArgs) Handles btCompute.Click
        Dim diagnostic As WindowsDiagnosticRun = Nothing
        Dim run As WindowsExecutionRun = Nothing
        Dim enabledControls As New Dictionary(Of Control, Boolean)()
        Dim priorSynchronizationContext As System.Threading.SynchronizationContext = Nothing
        Dim installedUiContext As Boolean = False
        Try
            If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.OneWayANOVA OrElse Me.Tag = HelpTopic.KruskalWallisTest Then
                ' Excel-DNA shows this form modelessly from a Ribbon callback. It may
                ' not have installed a WinForms synchronization context, in which case
                ' a continuation could leave the UI thread. The entire Excel COM
                ' and WinForms continuation must execute on the owning Excel UI thread.
                priorSynchronizationContext = System.Threading.SynchronizationContext.Current
                If Not TypeOf priorSynchronizationContext Is WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext Then
                    System.Threading.SynchronizationContext.SetSynchronizationContext(
                        New WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext())
                    installedUiContext = True
                End If
                run = executionDispatcher.TryBegin()
                If run Is Nothing Then Return
                executionRun = run
                LastSharedWriteOutcome = Nothing
                lastPilotFault = Nothing
                For Each control As Control In Controls
                    If control Is executionPanel Then Continue For
                    enabledControls.Add(control, control.Enabled)
                    control.Enabled = False
                Next
                executionCancel.Enabled = True
                AddHandler run.Execution.Changed, Sub(snapshot)
                                                      If IsDisposed Then Return
                                                      Dim current = run.Execution.Snapshot
                                                      executionLabel.Text = current.State.ToString() & " | " & current.Stage.ToString() &
                                                          If(current.Percent.HasValue, " | " & current.Percent.ToString() & "%", "")
                                                  End Sub
                run.Execution.Start()
                diagnostic = New WindowsDiagnosticRun(If(Me.Tag = HelpTopic.OneWayANOVA,
                    Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.AnalysisIds.OneWayAnova, Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.AnalysisIds.KruskalWallis),
                    CoreServices.TraceExecutionLoggingEnabled, ExcelDnaHost.Diagnostics)
                executionLabel.AccessibleDescription = "Run " & diagnostic.RunId
                If Me.checkInputs() Then
                    diagnostic.Reject()
                    ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest, "Invalid selection")), diagnostic)
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                BindPilotLifecycle(run)
                ' Yield once with the normal message loop; all continuations retain UI ownership.
                Await System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Yield()
                run.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Validation, 5)
            End If
            Dim errText As String = String.Empty
            Dim MWdata As TwoGroupsData, data As MultiGroupsUnpairedData

            'Validate Inputs
            If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnpairedTTest Then
                If Me.ValidateUnpairedTtestOptionInputs() Then Exit Sub
            Else
                If run Is Nothing AndAlso Me.checkInputs() Then
                    If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                        diagnostic.Reject()
                        ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest, "Invalid selection")), diagnostic)
                    End If
                    Exit Sub
                End If
            End If
            If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then diagnostic.EnterStage("acquisition")
            If run IsNot Nothing Then run.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Acquisition, 10)

            If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.CategoricalHistogram OrElse Me.Tag = HelpTopic.ViolinPlot Then
                Dim groupedData As GroupedContinuousInputData = Me.getGroupedContinuousData(errText)
                If errText <> String.Empty Then
                    MsgBox(errText, vbExclamation)
                    Exit Sub
                End If

                If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.CategoricalHistogram Then
                    Me.RunCategoricalHistogram(groupedData)
                Else
                    Me.RunViolinPlot(groupedData)
                End If

            ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.MannWhitneyTest Or Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnpairedTTest Or Me.Tag = HelpTopic.ROCCurve Then

                'Get Data
                MWdata = Me.getData2Groups(errText)
                If errText <> String.Empty Then
                    MsgBox(errText, vbExclamation)
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                data = New MultiGroupsUnpairedData
                data.X = {MWdata.X1, MWdata.X2}
                data.varNames = {MWdata.name1, MWdata.name2}

                If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.MannWhitneyTest Then
                    Me.RunMannWhitney(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnpairedTTest Then
                    Me.RunTtest(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.ROCCurve Then
                    Me.RunROC(data)
                End If
            Else
                'Get Data
                data = Me.getDataMultipleGroups(errText)
                run?.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()
                If run IsNot Nothing Then run.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Analysis, 30)
                If errText <> String.Empty Then
                    If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                        diagnostic.Reject()
                        ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromAnalysisFault(New AnalysisFault(AnalysisFaultCodes.InvalidRequest, "Invalid grouped input")), diagnostic)
                    Else
                        MsgBox(errText, vbExclamation)
                    End If
                    Exit Sub
                End If
                If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then diagnostic.EnterStage("analysis")

                'Run analysis
                If Me.Tag = HelpTopic.KruskalWallisTest Then
                    Me.RunKruskallWalis(data, diagnostic)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.BoxAndWhiskers Then
                    Me.RunBoxAndWhiskers(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.OneWayANOVA Then
                    Me.RunOneWayANOVA(data, diagnostic)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.DescriptiveStatistics Then
                    Me.RunDescStat(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.NormalityTests Then
                    Me.RunNormality(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.Histogram Then
                    Me.RunHistogram(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.NormalPlot Then
                    Me.RunNormalPlot(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.HomogeneityOfVariance Then
                    Me.RunHomogeneityVar(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.Symmetry Then
                    Me.RunSymmetry(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.UnivariateOutliers Then
                    Me.RunOutliers(data)
                ElseIf Me.Tag = HelpTopic.CDFplot Then
                    Me.RunCDFPlot(data)
                End If
            End If
        Catch ex As OperationCanceledException When run IsNot Nothing AndAlso ex.CancellationToken = run.Execution.Token AndAlso run.Execution.Snapshot.IsCancellationRequested
            run.Execution.TryFail(ex)
            If Not IsDisposed Then executionLabel.Text = run.FailureDisplay(ex, LastSharedWriteOutcome, If(diagnostic Is Nothing, Nothing, diagnostic.RunId))
        Catch ex As Exception
            If run IsNot Nothing Then run.Execution.TryFail(ex)
            If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                ' Native exception text can contain workbook paths/values. Retain only
                ' the run/stage and a mapped code in the default pilot diagnostic log.
                Try
                    CoreServices.Logger.Warn("ANOVA/KW execution failed. Run " & diagnostic.RunId &
                        " | stage " & If(run Is Nothing, "unknown", run.Execution.Snapshot.Stage.ToString()) &
                        " | code " & UserFaultMapper.FromException(ex).Code)
                Catch
                    ' A logging failure must never mask the original host exception.
                End Try
                If TypeOf ex Is SpreadsheetInputValidationException Then
                    diagnostic.Reject()
                Else
                    diagnostic.Fail()
                End If
                ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromOutcome(run.Execution.Snapshot, LastSharedWriteOutcome, ex), diagnostic)
            Else
                CoreServices.Errors.LogAndThrow(ex, False, True)
            End If
        Finally
            If run IsNot Nothing Then
                If Not run.Execution.Snapshot.IsTerminal Then run.Execution.TryFail(New InvalidOperationException("Invocation did not complete."))
                Dim terminalFault = If(lastPilotFault, UserFaultMapper.FromOutcome(run.Execution.Snapshot, LastSharedWriteOutcome))
                run.Dispose()
                pilotWorkbook = Nothing : pilotWorksheet = Nothing : pilotTarget = Nothing
                pilotAcquisitionBookId = Nothing
                executionRun = Nothing
                If Not IsDisposed Then
                    executionLabel.Text = run.Execution.Snapshot.State.ToString() &
                        If(terminalFault Is Nothing, "", " | " & terminalFault.Code) & " | Run " & If(diagnostic Is Nothing, "", diagnostic.RunId)
                    executionToolTip.SetToolTip(executionLabel, UserFaultMapper.FormatDisplay(terminalFault, If(diagnostic Is Nothing, Nothing, diagnostic.RunId)))
                    executionCancel.Enabled = False
                    For Each pair In enabledControls
                        pair.Key.Enabled = pair.Value
                    Next
                End If
            End If
            If diagnostic IsNot Nothing Then
                diagnostic.Dispose()
                If activeSharedOutputRun IsNot Nothing Then activeSharedOutputRun.Diagnostics = Nothing
                activeSharedOutputRun = Nothing
            End If
            If installedUiContext Then
                System.Threading.SynchronizationContext.SetSynchronizationContext(priorSynchronizationContext)
            End If
        End Try
    End Sub

    Private Sub RunOutliers(data As MultiGroupsUnpairedData)
        Dim method = If(Me.optGrubbs.Checked, AssumptionOutlierMethod.Grubbs,
            If(Me.optRosner.Checked, AssumptionOutlierMethod.Rosner, AssumptionOutlierMethod.None))
        Dim prepared = WindowsAssumptionReportAdapter.Prepare(data,
            New AssumptionReportOptions(AssumptionReportKind.Outliers, outlierMethod:=method,
                alpha:=Me.spinBtnAlphaOutliers.Value, descriptive:=Me.ckDescriptive_Outliers.Checked,
                boxSummary:=Me.ckBoxPlot_Outliers.Checked))
        Dim res = prepared.Tables
        Dim box = prepared.Box

        'Dump outputs
        Dim WriteRes = GetResultWriter() 'pass just table from the main test output
        Dim rr = New ProcessListofResultTables(res)
        Dim totrows As Integer = rr.TotRows + res.Count - 1 'one blank row as a separator
        Dim totcols As Integer = rr.TotCols
        If AreaCheck(WriteRes.RowID, WriteRes.ColID, totrows, totcols, WriteRes.ws) Then
            If MsgBox("Output range not empty! Overwrite?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Overwrite?") = vbNo Then
                Exit Sub
            End If
        End If

    Private Function ParseCDFPercentiles() As Double()
        Dim textValue As String = If(Me.txtCDFPercentiles.Text, String.Empty).Trim()
        If textValue = String.Empty Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("Enter at least one percentile between 0 and 100.")
        End If

        textValue = textValue.Replace(ControlChars.Cr, ";").Replace(ControlChars.Lf, ";").Replace(ControlChars.Tab, ";")

        Dim decimalSeparator As String = Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.NumberFormat.NumberDecimalSeparator
        If decimalSeparator <> "," Then textValue = textValue.Replace(",", ";")

        Dim tokens() As String = textValue.Split(New Char() {";"c}, StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries)
        Dim values As New List(Of Double)()

        For Each token As String In tokens
            Dim trimmed As String = token.Trim()
            If trimmed = String.Empty Then Continue For

            Dim percentile As Double
            Dim parsed As Boolean = Double.TryParse(trimmed,
                                                    Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,
                                                    Globalization.CultureInfo.CurrentCulture,
                                                    percentile)
            If Not parsed Then
                parsed = Double.TryParse(trimmed,
                                         Globalization.NumberStyles.Float,
                                         Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                                         percentile)
            End If

            If Not parsed Then
                Throw New ArgumentException("Invalid percentile value '" & trimmed & "'. Use semicolons to separate values, for example 25; 50; 75.")
            End If
            If Double.IsNaN(percentile) OrElse Double.IsInfinity(percentile) OrElse percentile <= 0.0R OrElse percentile >= 100.0R Then
                Throw New ArgumentOutOfRangeException(NameOf(txtCDFPercentiles),
                                                      "Percentiles must be greater than 0 and less than 100.")
            End If

            If Not values.Any(Function(value As Double) Math.Abs(value - percentile) <= 0.000000000001R) Then
                values.Add(percentile)
            End If
        Next

        If values.Count = 0 Then
            Throw New ArgumentException("Enter at least one percentile between 0 and 100.")
        End If

        values.Sort()
        Return values.ToArray()
    End Function

        'request/result boundary. Welch and post-hoc procedures are orchestrated once in

    Private Sub RunOneWayANOVAThroughSharedLayer(data As MultiGroupsUnpairedData, diagnostic As WindowsDiagnosticRun)
        Dim alpha As Double = AppGlobals.DefaultAlpha
        Dim box As graphics.BoxPlot = Nothing
        Dim options As New AnovaGroupedWorkflowOptions(SpreadsheetAnalysisKind.OneWayAnova,
            alpha:=alpha, welch:=Me.ckWelch.Checked, lsd:=Me.ckLSD.Checked,
            bonferroni:=Me.ckBonferroni.Checked, tukey:=Me.ckTukey.Checked, gamesHowell:=Me.ckGamesHowell.Checked,
            homogeneity:=GetHomogeneityMethods(), descriptive:=Me.ckDescriptiveStatistics.Checked,
            boxSummary:=Me.ckBoxPlot.Checked)
        Dim workflow = WindowsAnovaWorkflowAdapter.AnalyzeGrouped(data, options)
        Dim analysisResult = workflow.LegacyAnalysis

        executionRun.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Analysis, 60)

        Dim sharedResult = TryCast(analysisResult.Detail, OneWayAnovaApplicationResult)
        If sharedResult Is Nothing Then
            Throw New InvalidOperationException("The shared one-way ANOVA dispatcher did not return its typed detail result.")
        End If
        Dim prepared = WindowsAnovaWorkflowAdapter.PrepareSupplements(data, workflow.Options)
        Dim res = prepared.Tables
        box = prepared.Box
        Dim plotData = workflow.ComparisonPlots
        If Not RunSharedOutput(Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.AnalysisIds.OneWayAnova, analysisResult, res, alpha,
            Function(writer, totalColumns)
                Dim charts As New List(Of System.Action)()
                If Me.ckBoxPlot.Checked Then charts.Add(Sub()
                                                           box.SetWs = writer.ws
                                                           box.AddBoxPlot()
                                                       End Sub)
                Dim chartTop As Double? = Nothing
                For Each pd As parametric.MultipleComparisonPlotData In plotData
                    Dim captured = pd
                    charts.Add(Sub()
                                   Dim chartLeft As Double = CDbl(writer.ws.Cells(writer.RowID, writer.ColID + totalColumns + 2).Left)
                                   If Not chartTop.HasValue Then chartTop = CDbl(writer.ws.Cells(writer.RowID, writer.ColID).Top)
                                   graphics.MultipleComparisonPlotExcel.AddPlot(writer.ws, captured, chartLeft, chartTop.Value)
                                   chartTop += graphics.MultipleComparisonPlotExcel.SuggestedHeight(captured) + 15.0
                               End Sub)
                Next
                Return charts
            End Function, diagnostic) Then Exit Sub
    End Sub

    Private Sub RunBoxAndWhiskers(data As MultiGroupsUnpairedData)
        Dim res = New List(Of ResultTable)
        Dim box = New graphics.BoxPlot(data.X, data.varNames)
        box.Calculate()
        box.CalcForPlotting()
        res.Add(box.wrapResults())

        'Compute descriptive statistics. The standalone box-plot page has its own
        'checkbox; the generic option remains reserved for analyses that optionally
        'add a box plot to another statistical procedure.
        If Me.ckDescriptiveStatistics_Box.Checked Then res.Add(Me.ComputeDescriptiveStats(data))

        'Dump outputs
        Dim WriteRes = GetResultWriter() 'pass just table from the main test output
        Dim rr = New ProcessListofResultTables(res)
        Dim totrows As Integer = rr.TotRows + res.Count - 1 'one blank row as a separator
        Dim totcols As Integer = rr.TotCols
        If AreaCheck(WriteRes.RowID, WriteRes.ColID, totrows, totcols, WriteRes.ws) Then
            If MsgBox("Output range not empty! Overwrite?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Overwrite?") = vbNo Then
                Exit Sub
            End If
        End If

        rr.writeToSheet(WriteRes, True)

        box.SetWs = WriteRes.ws
        Dim appearance As graphics.BoxPlotAppearance = Me.GetStandaloneBoxPlotAppearance()
        If appearance Is Nothing Then
            'The special legacy preset intentionally uses the original AddBoxPlot()
            'path without custom dimensions or display settings, so its output is
            'identical to the historical BESHStat box plot.
            box.AddBoxPlot()
        Else
            box.AddBoxPlot(appearance,
                           CDbl(Me.nudBoxChartWidth.Value),
                           CDbl(Me.nudBoxChartHeight.Value))
        End If
    End Sub

    Private Sub ShowPilotFault(fault As UserFault, diagnostic As WindowsDiagnosticRun)
        If fault Is Nothing Then Return
        lastPilotFault = fault
        If IsDisposed Then Return
        MsgBox(UserFaultMapper.FormatDisplay(fault, If(diagnostic Is Nothing, Nothing, diagnostic.RunId)),

    Private Function RunSharedOutput(analysisId As String, result As Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetAnalysisResult,
                                     supplementary As List(Of ResultTable), alpha As Double,
                                     charts As Func(Of ExcelDnaResultWriter, Integer, IReadOnlyList(Of System.Action)),
                                     diagnostic As WindowsDiagnosticRun) As Boolean
        executionRun.Checkpoint(ExecutionStage.Output, 90)
        executionCancel.Enabled = False ' No interruption/rollback of the synchronous write.
        diagnostic.OutputAttempted()
        activeSharedOutputRun = New ExcelDnaSharedOutputRun() With {.Diagnostics = diagnostic}
        Dim host As New ExcelDnaSharedOutputHost With {
            .Revalidate = Sub()
                              executionRun.Execution.ThrowIfCancellationRequested()
                              executionRun.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()
                          End Sub,
            .Acquire = Function(run) GetSharedResultWriter(analysisId, result, supplementary),
            .Target = Function(writer) New Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetOutputTarget With {
                .Destination = activeSharedOutputRun.RequestedTarget.Destination, .WorksheetName = CStr(writer.ws.Name),
                .StartRow = writer.RowID, .StartColumn = writer.ColID},
            .Identities = Function(writer) Tuple.Create(ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.TargetIdentity(writer.wb), ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.TargetIdentity(writer.ws)),
            .InspectCharts = Function(writer, intent) ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.InspectChartSafety(intent, writer.wb, writer.ws),
            .ConfirmCharts = Function(observed) MsgBox("This sheet contains " & observed.ExistingShapeCount.ToString() &
                " existing chart(s) or shape(s). New charts will be added. Excel chooses some chart positions, so visual overlap cannot be checked in advance." &
                vbCrLf & "Continue adding charts and writing output?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Add charts?") = vbYes,
            .Charts = charts,
            .Inspect = Function(writer, intent) ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.InspectWrite(intent, writer.wb, writer.ws),
            .Confirm = Function(observed) MsgBox("Output range not empty! Overwrite?", vbYesNo + vbExclamation, "Overwrite?") = vbYes}
        executionRun.Write(Function()
                               LastSharedWriteOutcome = activeSharedOutputRun.Execute(result, supplementary, AppGlobals.PValuePresentation, alpha, host)
                               diagnostic.OutputFinished(LastSharedWriteOutcome.State)
                               Return LastSharedWriteOutcome.State
                           End Function)
        If LastSharedWriteOutcome.State = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.OutputWriteState.Completed Then Return True
        If LastSharedWriteOutcome.State <> Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.OutputWriteState.CancelledByUser Then
            ShowPilotFault(UserFaultMapper.FromWriteResult(LastSharedWriteOutcome), diagnostic)
        End If
        Return False
    End Function
    ' Only ANOVA/KW: preserve validated target objects through native destination creation.
    Private Function GetSharedResultWriter(analysisId As String,
                                          result As Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetAnalysisResult,
                                          supplementary As List(Of ResultTable)) As ExcelDnaResultWriter
        executionRun.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()
        Dim target As New SpreadsheetOutputTarget With {.Destination = pilotTarget.Destination,
            .WorksheetName = pilotTarget.WorksheetName, .StartRow = pilotTarget.StartRow, .StartColumn = pilotTarget.StartColumn}
        Dim workbook As Workbook = pilotWorkbook
        Dim worksheet As Worksheet = pilotWorksheet
        activeSharedOutputRun.RequestedTarget = target
        Dim extras As New List(Of ResultTableOutputModel)
        For Each table As ResultTable In supplementary
            extras.Add(table.ToOutputModel())
        Next
        activeSharedOutputRun.Stage = "precreation-plan"
        Dim document = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.OutputDocument.FromResult(result)
        activeSharedOutputRun.Stage = "capability-check"
        ExcelDnaHostCapabilities.EnsureCanWrite(analysisId, target)
        activeSharedOutputRun.Stage = "target-facts"
        Dim facts = ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.Inspect(workbook, worksheet, target.Destination)
        activeSharedOutputRun.Stage = "preflight"
        Dim bounds = ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.Preflight(target, facts,
            document, extras)
        If worksheet IsNot Nothing Then
            Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.TargetPlanner.Create(target, ExcelDnaHostCapabilities.GetSnapshot(),
                ExcelDnaOutputTargetAdapter.Inspect(workbook, worksheet, target.Destination, bounds)).EnsureSupported()
        End If
        activeSharedOutputRun.RequestedTarget = target
        activeSharedOutputRun.Stage = "destination-creation"
        executionRun.Lifecycle.EnsureCurrent()
        ' Keep the exact objects validated above; do not re-read ActiveWorkbook after
        ' adding a sheet/book or re-resolve a potentially changed RefEdit destination.
        Dim writer As New ExcelDnaResultWriter(target.StartRow, target.StartColumn)
        If target.Destination = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorkbook Then
            activeSharedOutputRun.CreationAttempted = True
            writer.wb = AppGlobals.app.Workbooks.Add()
            activeSharedOutputRun.DestinationCreated = True
            writer.ws = DirectCast(writer.wb.Worksheets(1), Worksheet)
        ElseIf target.Destination = Global.BESHStatNG.ExcelCommon.SpreadsheetOutputDestination.NewWorksheet Then
            writer.wb = workbook
            activeSharedOutputRun.CreationAttempted = True
            writer.ws = DirectCast(workbook.Worksheets.Add(), Worksheet)
            activeSharedOutputRun.DestinationCreated = True
        Else
            writer.wb = workbook
            writer.ws = worksheet
        End If
        Dim createdBook = writer.wb, createdSheet = writer.ws
        executionRun.Lifecycle.Watch(Function() WindowsDocumentLifecycle.Observe(AppGlobals.app, createdBook, createdSheet))
        Return writer
    End Function

    Private Function GetResultWriter() As ExcelDnaResultWriter
        Dim WriteRes = New ExcelDnaResultWriter, rRange As Range
        If Me.optWorkbook.Checked Then

    Private Function ValidateUnpairedTtestOptionInputs() As Boolean
